analysis:
The only change in this PR is a documentation edit to docs/architecture/inference.md: one table row at line 2126, the `stop` parameter mapping. It now says Gemma 4 and `<think>` parsers exclude reasoning and tool-call spans from stop-string matching (`ReasoningStopScope`), and that the native block engine matches the whole output with no scope. The two supplied units (base lines 4003-4494) are unchanged context from other sections of the same file. They cover GLM/Qwen tensor-parallel placement, the sealed all-sum, the cluster SSD prefix records, and the GPT-OSS and Gemma sections. They are not modified by the patch, so I treated them as pre-existing content and raised nothing from them.

No code, key handling, attestation, authorization, encryption or trust-boundary behavior changes. The documented stop-scope behavior is an output-handling semantic. Its only security-relevant link is to the stop-sequence replay in EngineV2Bridge+StopSequence.swift, which is not in the supplied evidence and so is unreviewed. Any threat-model impact (T-008, T-041) is nil from this diff.

The patch excerpt is complete, and the changed line sits outside the supplied unit ranges. The claim about runtime behavior of ReasoningStopScope can't be verified here, but a doc edit alone does not create a regression. No threat-model update is needed.
